formatted_sql:
SELECT
  c.customer_id,
  c.customer_name,
  COUNT(o.order_id) AS completed_order_count
FROM dim_customers AS c
LEFT JOIN fact_orders AS o
  ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id AND o.status = 'completed'
GROUP BY
  c.customer_id,
  c.customer_name
ORDER BY
  completed_order_count DESC,
  c.customer_id ASC
